seo_title: Custom Shift Management Software for SMEs
seo_desc: Is scheduling your team's shifts a mess in Excel? We develop custom databases and software to manage rosters without overlaps or compliance issues.
author_pitch: As a Database Architect, it seems crazy to me to see managers of small clinics, restaurants, or cleaning companies wasting their entire Sunday trying to balance shifts in an Excel spreadsheet. A small mistake leaves your business understaffed or violates labor laws. I build custom systems and relational databases that automate roster creation, track vacations, and manage shift swaps in real time, so your operations flow like clockwork.
title: The scheduling puzzle: Custom Software Development for Shift Management
body:
Does your small business waste hours every week trying to balance employee schedules in an Excel spreadsheet that always ends up full of errors and overlaps?

In businesses where service must be continuous (clinics, hospitality, small factories, or cleaning companies), organizing who works each day is a real Sudoku puzzle. The manager has to cross-reference vacation requests, medical leaves, legal hour limits, and last-minute changes requested via WhatsApp. Doing this on a spreadsheet or on paper guarantees mistakes: one day you are overstaffed and the next you are short-handed during rush hour, generating operational chaos that harms your service quality and exhausts your team.

The trap of Generic Human Resources Apps

To try and bring order, many SMEs hire standard shift applications that force them to adapt their collective agreements and internal rules to what the machine allows. Forcing your business's unique operations to fit into a rigid program and paying for every worker you add is a burden on your growth.

Our solution: Custom Roster Database and Software

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we turn scheduling chaos into mathematical precision. As software architects, we develop web applications connected to a solid relational database, programming your exact business rules to manage your workforce's availability automatically and without monthly per-user fees.

  1. Custom Labor Rules Engine: We configure the database with the hour limits, mandatory breaks, and specific collective agreements of your company, physically preventing the assignment of an illegal shift.
  2. Smart Roster Generation: The system cross-references staff availability and automatically suggests optimal schedules, covering demand peaks based on the skills of each employee.
  3. Integrated Employee Portal: Your team accesses a lightweight web interface from their mobile where they can see their up-to-the-second schedule, request time off, or manage approved shift swaps.
  4. Time Tracking and Payroll Control: We link the theoretical roster with the actual clock-in and clock-out records, generating exact reports of overtime and absences ready to send to your accountant.

The Real Impact on your Business Operations

  • Management Time Recovery: You go from taking days to plan the month to generating and publishing the entire team's schedules in just a few minutes, completely stress-free.
  • Perfect Service Coverage: You eradicate understaffing and overlaps, ensuring you always have the right personnel at the critical moment to serve your clients.
  • Legal and Labor Peace of Mind: By automating agreement compliance and accurately recording workdays, you protect your company against potential labor inspections or internal conflicts.
